title: Beach Read
author: Emily Henry
summary: A romance writer who has stopped believing in happy endings and a literary novelist with writer's block live next door for a summer. They make a bet to swap genres and end up swapping far more than that.
readIf: You want a romance that makes you laugh and then quietly breaks your heart.
skipIf: You want a light read with no grief or family hurt in it.

pairings.reason: Equally funny and romantic, with a bigger, brighter setting and less sadness.
If the emotional weight is what you liked, this one goes deeper into love, loss and secrets.
